matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the inconsistency between spatial masking preserving POI/road modalities (Section 4.2) and the inability to recover them (Section 4.1.4 only recovers spatial/temporal). This directly detects the ground truth's contradiction about which modalities are masked and recovered when spatial modality is masked.

No finding addresses the SC-MoE gating mechanism's missing details about noise distribution, gating vector constraints, or how noisy top-K balances diversity with stability. Finding 2 discusses masking protocols, and Finding 3 discusses loss functions—both different loci from the MoE gating logic.
